address: 15, Lane 25, Shuangcheng Street, Zhongshan District, Taipei, 104, Taiwan
bio: A smart Italian restaurant whose passionate owner and team strive to ensure that “everything is good”. In both the set and à la carte menus, the chef reinterprets traditional recipes with creative touches and varied flavour profiles. The well-curated wine list sees a vast array of interesting vintages. The wine flight tray serves eight glasses at the same time, perfect for wine buffs who want to sample different labels by the glass.
